svg.aria-label: Two side-by-side histograms: how a real image is assigned to five synthetic prototypes under two augmented views. The distributions overlap by 88 percent.
svg.title: Two side-by-side histograms: how a real image is assigned to five synthetic prototypes under two augmented views. The distributions overlap by 88 percent.
svg.text: A real image is soft-assigned to synthetic prototypes under two independent augmentations.
The pixels differ between views, yet the same few prototypes receive most of the probability. Top five of ten shown.

text.tspan: of the probability mass is shared by the two views

svg.text: Bar values are the assignment probabilities printed in the paper’s Fig. 1a; the images are illustrative renderings.
